column1: THE TWELVE ORDERED PAIRWISE COMPARISONS OVER THE 41 ROWS.
The comparison is ROW BY ROW on the exact row IDs, not a summary
count.  A pair PASSES only when every one of the 41 row IDs is
present in BOTH members and every observed value is equal.
